# Frozen Kingdom

Frozen Kingdom applies a Nord palette its recorded description calls frost-bitten and mathematically optimized for contrast. A deep glowing dark mode and a frosted-parchment light mode are both offered, and the description adds Excel-like crosshair highlighting for table readability and depth-aware rainbow folder accents.

![Frozen Kingdom screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sto3iv/obsidian-fancy-a-story-frozen/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Frozen Kingdom"
    author: "Adelia"
    repo:   "sto3iv/obsidian-fancy-a-story-frozen"
    slug:   "frozen-kingdom"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/frozen-kingdom"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/sto3iv/obsidian-fancy-a-story-frozen"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sto3iv/obsidian-fancy-a-story-frozen/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a frost-bitten Nord palette with mathematically optimized contrast for clear, icy colors across the interface. Switch between a deep glowing dark mode and a frosted-parchment light mode. Improve table readability with Excel-like crosshair highlighting and add depth-aware rainbow folder accents."
}
```
